items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The bass player was Frazier. And Frazier(?) was a guy that played in all the carnivals... And I remember Frazier was with us when they changed the size of the money.

ctx.x: And Frazier's... Frazier was before you were in the band. Frazier's father was an insurance man. He was from Memphis. Well, we'll get to that later on.
We'll get to that. So when did Joe first...?
